changelog:
v3.5.7 — VLC Stability & HEVC Slideshow Fix

• Fixed: libVLC native crash on MTK devices (AFTKRT, AFTMM) when swapping to VLC for HEVC Main 10 content. Added crash guard that prevents repeated crashes.
• Fixed: HEVC slideshow on software decoder — channels using regular HEVC on MTK devices (8fps slideshow) now auto-swap to libVLC after 6 seconds instead of playing unwatchably forever.
• Stability: VLC swap timing improved to prevent native initialization race condition.
